verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Stripe Crypto & Stablecoins generating AI insights or suggestions from a user's data inside the product. The MCP server only gives external AI agents tools to call the Stripe API, which is a developer building block rather than in-product AI insights. Machine payments are a different capability. A payments product could plausibly offer this, so the axis applies and the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
